papers.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
papers.translated_title: 语言模型能玩维基百科游戏吗？
papers.author: Alexander Hickey
papers.summary: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
papers.translated_summary: 语言模型越来越多地支持或自动化从大到无法索引的文档集合中进行信息检索。当这项任务需要专业的语言学或科学知识时，它就变得困难。我们使用维基百科游戏来测试语言模型在类似信息检索任务上的表现。在游戏中，玩家必须仅使用文章链接到达目标文章。我们比较了句子嵌入模型和大语言模型在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上的表现。我们使用 OpenAlex 构建了非常大的维基百科页面和论文引用的本地图，并提供了构建和导航这些图的代码。这使得研究语言模型的导航能力无需依赖第三方 API。我们将这些模型与人类和 TF-IDF 基准进行了比较。维基百科游戏格式能够实现跨技术、语言和领域的稳健比较。没有模型显著优于人类，尽管最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B 和 DeepSeek-R1:70B）取得了相当的成功。性能和排名因语言和主题而异，这对利用这些技术的从业者具有启示意义。

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
papers.translated_title: 面向物理落地的铰接式3D资产：多智能体流水线与基准
papers.author: Xudong Cai
papers.summary: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
papers.translated_summary: 在本文中，我们研究基于物理的铰接式3D资产生成——将目标从复现物体的外观转向捕捉其运动方式和功能。受程序化生成和智能体生成文献的启发，我们提出了Artisan，一个扩展了最新方法Articraft的系统，通过引入带有物理仿真反馈的多智能体流水线，实现了超越几何、外观和物理合理铰接的全面属性，例如无碰撞运动、重力下的稳定性以及准确的质量和材料属性。此外，我们构建了一个涵盖四个关键方面的统一基准：空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务性能和整体质量。该基准包含来自ArtVIP和LightWheel的100个参考资产、50个稳定性提示，以及50个带有参考质量的ABO物体，并采用评估各种指标的协议。通过对超过10个代表性模型的广泛评估，Artisan在实现具有竞争力的空间保真度的同时，在所评估的方法中达到了最低的碰撞率和最高的稳定性率。我们的系统和基准共同为推进3D生成走向物理合理、功能可用的资产提供了洞见。

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.translated_title: Splat2Act：从捕获场景到个性化VLA操作
papers.author: Xiaomeng Ye
papers.summary: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
papers.translated_summary: 将通用操作策略带入家庭或办公室的用户希望它能够从架子、台面和桌子上拾取物品。然而，即使是像$π_{0.5}$这样强大的通用策略，在我们捕获的部署场景中未经适配也实现了0%的拾取成功率，而在每个用户环境中收集真实演示的成本高得令人望而却步。我们提出Splat2Act，一种自动化的真实到仿真再到真实的流水线，仅使用手持手机扫描和用户物品的图像，就能将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略个性化到特定场景和物品集。与先前重建单个桌面的真实到仿真工作不同，Splat2Act在建筑尺度的室内环境中运行：它使用3D高斯泼溅和碰撞几何构建逼真的数字孪生，自动发现桌面和非桌面容器，构建可行的拾取任务，并使用特权仿真预言机生成成功演示，人类只需提供场景和物品捕获。应用于101个扫描的校园环境（中位可导航面积为104.87 m$^2$，7个容器），该流水线产生了852个容器和超过68,000个拾取演示。我们分两个阶段微调$π_{0.5}$：阶段1适配数百个公共物品资产，这些资产要么仅来自部署场景，要么来自全部101个场景；阶段2在部署场景的容器上个性化到用户自己的物品。我们最强的个性化策略在目标场景中达到62.5%的总体拾取成功率。部署在真实的Stretch 3上，同一策略在12个任务的子集上达到63.9%的成功率，与其在这些任务上66.7%的仿真成功率密切吻合。这些结果表明，自动化的真实到仿真再到真实训练可以仅使用仿真预言机数据来个性化VLA操作策略。

papers.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
papers.translated_title: InstantFusion：异构图像生成器的共享潜在接口
papers.author: Xuanlang Dai
papers.summary: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
papers.translated_summary: 扩散/流模型已成为图像生成的事实上的范式，催生了多样化的现代生成器家族，其架构和表示日益异构。尽管这些模型具有卓越的生成能力，但潜在表示的跨模型对齐及其底层去噪动态的一致性仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们揭示了一个有趣的跨模型兼容性：独立训练的生成器表现出相似的潜在空间组织，而直接在未对齐的模型之间传递中间状态仍能保留粗略的视觉内容。受这些观察的启发，我们提出了InstantFusion，一种轻量级的共享潜在接口，用于连接异构图像生成器的去噪轨迹。具体而言，为了实现灵活的跨模型状态转换，我们引入了模型特定的潜在自编码器（LAEs），将来自不同生成器的中间状态投影到共享潜在空间，并将其解码到目标生成器的潜在空间中。该共享空间受两个互补目标的约束：在匹配噪声水平下对齐来自同一图像的中间状态，并同步其对应的局部去噪速度。一旦训练完成，InstantFusion允许去噪在冻结的生成器之间无缝过渡，而无需为每一对模型专门映射。InstantFusion的多功能性在加速、多偏好组合、跨架构在线策略蒸馏和跨模型组合中得到了展示，在这些多样化设置中均取得了有竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Images Talk Back: Guiding MMDiTs by Suppressing Image-to-Text Feedback
papers.translated_title: 图像回话：通过抑制图像到文本反馈来引导MMDiT
papers.author: Yucheng Yang
papers.summary: Multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs) allow the evolving image to update internal text representations through joint attention. These representations then guide subsequent image updates, raising a question: does this feedback help correct deviations from the prompt, or preserve them? We find that image-to-text (I2T) feedback can preserve the objects and attributes already represented in the evolving image, including errors. Transplanting I2T messages can rescue failures or disrupt successes. At matched intervention strengths, suppressing the influence of I2T feedback improves generation, whereas opposite controls degrade it. These findings motivate Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG), which suppresses the influence of I2T feedback by guiding away from an auxiliary branch that strengthens this feedback and weakens text-to-image conditioning. The in-place variant, iSFG, directly suppresses I2T feedback and strengthens text-to-image conditioning, requiring no extra model evaluations. Temporal interventions motivate running the SFG branch during the first 20% of image sampling steps, requiring about $1.2\times$ the base NFE without classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments across three image-generation backbones show gains in alignment and preference-model scores. On FLUX, adding SFG to CFG raises GenEval from $0.6661$ to $0.7479$; on SD3.5M, iSFG adds $+1.33$ HPSv2.1 over CFG at zero extra NFE. The control also transfers to text-to-video and image-to-video generation, improving VBench scores. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态扩散变换器（MMDiTs）通过联合注意力机制，使演化中的图像能够更新内部文本表示。这些表示随后引导后续的图像更新，由此引出一个问题：这种反馈是有助于纠正与提示词的偏差，还是会保留这些偏差？我们发现，图像到文本（I2T）反馈能够保留演化图像中已经表示的物体和属性，包括错误。移植I2T信息可以挽救失败或破坏成功。在匹配的干预强度下，抑制I2T反馈的影响能够改善生成，而相反的控制则会使其退化。这些发现促成了语义反馈引导（SFG），它通过引导远离一个增强该反馈并削弱文本到图像条件的辅助分支，来抑制I2T反馈的影响。其原位变体iSFG直接抑制I2T反馈并增强文本到图像条件，无需额外的模型评估。时间干预促使在图像采样步骤的前20%运行SFG分支，在无分类器引导（CFG）的情况下需要约$1.2\times$的基础NFE。在三个图像生成骨干网络上的实验表明，在对齐度和偏好模型分数上均有提升。在FLUX上，将SFG添加到CFG使GenEval从$0.6661$提升至$0.7479$；在SD3.5M上，iSFG在零额外NFE的情况下比CFG增加了$+1.33$ HPSv2.1。该控制方法还可迁移至文本到视频和图像到视频生成，提升VBench分数。代码可在https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG获取。

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.translated_title: 捉迷藏：用HIDE概念为黑箱模型寻找解释
papers.author: Bhanu Tokas
papers.summary: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.translated_summary: 解读机器学习模型的预测是一项核心挑战，尤其是对于黑盒视觉模型而言。基于概念归因方法利用人类可理解的概念来解释模型。现有的基于概念的方法只能解释分类和回归模型。它们需要访问模型权重或大规模概念标注数据集，而且大多数方法无法提供图像级归因。我们提出了Hide and Seek（HnS），一种新的概念级归因方法，不需要访问模型权重或标注概念数据集。HnS可以解释多种视觉模型。给定一个概念和图像集，HnS使用视觉语言模型检索与概念对齐的图像，在每个图像中定位该概念，遮蔽所定位的区域，并通过测量黑盒模型在原始图像与遮蔽图像之间输出的变化来进行归因。这通过直接测量模型行为并支持局部归因，实现了忠实的归因。我们在CelebA和COCO-Stuff上验证了HnS。与现有方法相比，HnS与真实归因表现出更好的一致性。我们展示了HnS在多种任务上的适用性，包括图像描述和卫星图像分割，在这些任务中现有概念归因方法均无法使用。我们在补充材料中提供了匿名代码。

papers.title: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
papers.translated_title: 神经网络拓扑表达力的构造性界
papers.author: Kosio Beshkov
papers.summary: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
papers.translated_summary: 神经网络 $\Phi$ 的表达能力描述了网络能够表达的函数类。拓扑表达能力这一术语指的是一类特别适合理解二分类问题的度量，通常用决策边界 $\beta(\Phi^{-1}(0))$ 的 Betti 数来表述。尽管这一度量很受欢迎，但它对于回归以及其他不涉及决策边界的问题并不那么有用。相反，我们提出从神经网络输出 $\beta(\Phi(X))$ 的 Betti 数来研究拓扑表达能力。我们正式证明，一个具有架构 $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d }\beta_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}\beta_k(k+1))$ 的 ReLU 网络可以表达与具有任意 Betti 数的球面楔和同伦等价的空间。这给出了任意连通（$\beta_0=1$）Betti 数序列的上界，但通过构造与 $N$ 个维度为 $d_1,...,d_N$ 的球面的乘积同伦等价的空间，我们对于由 $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$ 给出的 Betti 数实现了更好的界 $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N)$。最后，我们猜想一个更强得多的紧界，它对于与球面同胚的空间给出架构界 $(d,d+1,d+1)$。

papers.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.translated_title: 时间政策：在物理时间上学习机器人策略
papers.author: Changhao Wang
papers.summary: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
papers.translated_summary: 机器人策略通常将传感与控制转换为固定速率的观测-动作序列，使物理时间隐含在序列位置中。当观测速率或延迟变化，或推理延迟改变时，这一假设就会失效。我们提出Chronos Policy，通过以观测捕获时间和期望动作执行时间为条件，使物理时间显式化。我们研究了将时间融入扩散Transformer的两种方式：向token特征添加时间戳嵌入，或通过时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）将物理时间编码到位置编码中。我们发现时间感知RoPE更为稳健，它允许注意力直接依赖于物理时间，同时保持token内容不变。在训练期间，我们对采样哪些观测以及动作块何时开始进行时间随机化，使策略接触到部署期间可能出现的更广泛的传感与执行调度。这也使得能够从异步、多速率数据中学习，而无需将所有测量强制对齐到固定时间网格。在仿真和真实世界实验中，Chronos Policy在动态任务上提升了性能，在这些任务中观测到动作的时序至关重要；在多感官任务上也提升了性能，在这些任务中观测之间的相对时序很重要。在标准准静态任务上，它保持了标称性能，同时提升了对传感和推理时序变化的鲁棒性。

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.translated_title: AI模型可证明地隐藏任意能力
papers.author: Andis Draguns
papers.summary: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.translated_summary: 能力评估旨在部署前暴露模型的危险行为，但其可靠性依赖于一个假设：隐藏能力可以被诱发出来。我们通过构造后门攻击表明，这一假设在对抗条件下并不成立。这些攻击将加密神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重中，仅在接收到秘密触发器时才解密并执行。利用数字锁柜，这些隐藏电路在密码学假设下可证明难以被诱发和解释，即使拥有对模型权重的完全访问权限，这也将先前从隐藏固定字符串的工作扩展到任意计算。我们在PyTorch中实现了概念验证构造，并在一个小型化学反应预测任务上通过微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索和潜在对抗训练来评估诱发效果——该任务可作为CBRN相关能力的代理。我们的结果证明了对这些方法的抵抗性，并且结合我们的密码学保证，揭示了基于诱发的 capability audits 的局限性。我们发布模型以支持防御的改进。

papers.title: Can machines reason non-verbally?
papers.translated_title: 机器能否进行非言语推理？
papers.author: Shaheer U. Saeed
papers.summary: Modern machines can solve equations, follow logic and reason through language, yet they still struggle with problems that require visual non-verbal reasoning. This is evident even in advanced systems such as DeepSeek, ChatGPT and Gemini, which remain limited on visual tasks such as completing abstract patterns or delineating ambiguous regions-of-interest. Unlike explicit intermediate steps in verbal reasoning which can be verified through logic or automated tests, visual reasoning involves implicit intermediate steps with no clear methods for verification. Non-verbal reasoning is therefore challenging to model and, as a result, remains a fundamental limitation of current machine intelligence. Here we introduce GenVerOpt, a general framework that unifies generation, verification and optimisation into a reasoning pipeline for machines. By generating candidate solutions, verifying their correctness, and iteratively refining them, GenVerOpt enables per-sample optimisation rather than relying solely on dataset-level trends captured during model training. This process mirrors human problem-solving where multiple possibilities are imagined, evaluated, and refined until a correct solution emerges. Across diverse domains, GenVerOpt demonstrates capabilities beyond existing systems: it surpasses humans on abstract IQ puzzles, matches clinicians in prostate cancer segmentation, exceeds experts in liver vessel reconstruction and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in tumour boundary alignment. These results show that machine reasoning can extend beyond language, establishing visual non-verbal reasoning as a foundation for more flexible and generalisable intelligence.
papers.translated_summary: 现代机器能够解方程、遵循逻辑并通过语言进行推理，但在需要视觉非语言推理的问题上仍然举步维艰。这一点即使在DeepSeek、ChatGPT和Gemini等先进系统中也很明显，它们在完成抽象图案或勾勒模糊感兴趣区域等视觉任务上仍然存在局限。与语言推理中可通过逻辑或自动化测试验证的显式中间步骤不同，视觉推理涉及隐式中间步骤，缺乏明确的验证方法。因此，非语言推理难以建模，并因此仍然是当前机器智能的一个根本性局限。在此，我们提出GenVerOpt，一个将生成、验证和优化统一为机器推理流水线的通用框架。通过生成候选解、验证其正确性并迭代改进，GenVerOpt能够实现逐样本优化，而非仅依赖模型训练过程中捕获的数据集层面趋势。这一过程类似于人类解决问题的方式：想象多种可能性，对其进行评估，并不断改进，直到出现正确解。在多个领域中，GenVerOpt展现出超越现有系统的能力：在抽象智商谜题上超越人类，在前列腺癌分割上媲美临床医生，在肝血管重建上超越专家，并在肿瘤边界对齐上优于最先进方法。这些结果表明，机器推理可以超越语言，将视觉非语言推理确立为更灵活、更具泛化能力的智能的基础。

papers.title: Linear NeuroPaint: An Efficient Baseline for Cross-Session Neural Alignment and Inpainting
papers.translated_title: 线性神经绘画：跨会话神经对齐与修复的高效基线
papers.author: Yao, Y. J.
papers.summary: Large-scale Neuropixels recordings sample many brain areas, but no single experimental session records every area of interest. NeuroPaint, a transformer-based autoencoder, integrates such recordings by aligning area-specific latent dynamics across sessions and "inpainting" activity in unrecorded areas. Could a linear model, which would be computationally efficient and potentially more interpretable, suffice to achieve this? To address this question, we introduce Linear NeuroPaint, a linear variant of NeuroPaint, and evaluate it on two multi-area Neuropixels datasets. Linear NeuroPaint achieves strong predictive performance on recorded areas, however, it is less accurate than nonlinear models at cross-area inpainting, despite extensive hyperparameter optimization. Moreover, its parameters are not readily interpretable: incomplete cross-session alignment leads parameter-defined neuron clusters to exhibit heterogeneous response profiles. Together, these results show that linear transformations are insufficient for cross-session alignment and cross-area prediction. Nevertheless, Linear NeuroPaint provides a computationally efficient baseline for benchmarking multi-session neural models.
papers.translated_summary: 大规模Neuropixels记录采样了许多脑区，但没有任何单一实验会话能记录所有感兴趣的脑区。NeuroPaint是一种基于Transformer的自编码器，通过跨会话对齐脑区特异性潜在动力学，并“修复”未记录脑区的活动，来整合此类记录。一个线性模型——计算高效且可能更具可解释性——是否足以实现这一目标？为回答这一问题，我们提出了Linear NeuroPaint，即NeuroPaint的线性变体，并在两个多脑区Neuropixels数据集上对其进行评估。Linear NeuroPaint在已记录脑区上取得了很强的预测性能，然而，尽管进行了广泛的超参数优化，其在跨脑区修复方面仍不如非线性模型准确。此外，其参数并不易于解释：不完整的跨会话对齐导致由参数定义的神经元簇表现出异质性反应特征。总之，这些结果表明，线性变换不足以实现跨会话对齐和跨脑区预测。尽管如此，Linear NeuroPaint为多会话神经模型的基准测试提供了一个计算高效的基线。

papers.title: Scalable methylome-transcriptome profiling resolves clonal organization in human hematopoiesis
papers.translated_title: 可扩展的甲基化组-转录组图谱解析人类造血中的克隆组织
papers.author: Shao, J.
papers.summary: Understanding human tissue maintenance and remodeling requires linking clonal ancestry to molecular state, yet scalable joint measurement remains challenging. Here, we introduce Droplet-MT and an integrated computational workflow for joint transcriptome and methylome profiling at ~10,000 cells per library. Methylation epimutations enable mutation-independent clonal reconstruction from high-coverage methylomes, while reference-based label transfer assigns cells to established clones at ~0.2% CpG coverage, reducing sequencing cost. Clone-aggregated somatic variants provide genetic annotation without additional single-cell genotyping. Across ~21,000 paired profiles from healthy blood and longitudinal acute myeloid leukemia, we resolved small and expanded clones with heterogeneous lineage output. In leukemia, the framework distinguished changes in malignant clonal abundance, state remodeling within persistent clones, and recovery of healthy polyclonal hematopoiesis. Malignant monocytes remained transcriptionally and epigenetically distinct from healthy and recovery-associated cells despite treatment-associated remodeling. Droplet-MT enables scalable analysis of human tissues by linking clonal organization with molecular state and retrospective genetic annotation.
papers.translated_summary: 理解人体组织的维持与重塑需要将克隆来源与分子状态联系起来，但可扩展的联合测量仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们介绍了Droplet-MT以及一套集成计算工作流程，用于每文库约10,000个细胞的转录组和甲基化组联合分析。甲基化表观突变使得能够从高覆盖度甲基化组中进行不依赖突变的克隆重建，而基于参考的标签转移可在约0.2% CpG覆盖度下将细胞分配到已建立的克隆，从而降低测序成本。克隆聚合的体细胞变异无需额外的单细胞基因分型即可提供遗传注释。在来自健康血液和纵向急性髓系白血病的约21,000个配对图谱中，我们解析了具有异质性谱系输出的小克隆和扩增克隆。在白血病中，该框架区分了恶性克隆丰度的变化、持续克隆内的状态重塑以及健康多克隆造血功能的恢复。尽管存在与治疗相关的重塑，恶性单核细胞在转录和表观遗传上仍与健康和恢复相关细胞明显不同。Droplet-MT通过将克隆组织与分子状态及回顾性遗传注释联系起来，实现了对人体组织的可扩展分析。

papers.title: An iPSC-based experimental framework for investigating phenotypic variation associated with Jomon ancestry in the present-day Japanese population
papers.translated_title: 基于iPSC的实验框架，用于研究当代日本人群中与绳文祖先相关的表型变异
papers.author: Nakamura, Y.
papers.summary: Ancestry-related genomic variation may contribute to phenotypic diversity. However, its cellular consequences remain difficult to evaluate. To address this, we developed a human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-based framework for investigating such phenotypes. We used the Japanese population as a model of Jomon-related and continental East Asian ancestry admixture. Jomon ancestry, estimated using the Jomon allele score (JAS), was associated with clinical measures, including renal-related traits and serum triglycerides in 34,152 Tohoku Medical Megabank participants. Peripheral blood mononuclear cell transcriptomics of donors from the upper and lower extremes of the JAS distribution (n = 10) suggested group-level differences in immune-related gene expression. To test whether the serum triglyceride association coincided with hepatic cellular phenotypes, we differentiated hiPSCs from these donors into hepatocyte-like cells. Neither intracellular triglycerides nor lipid-related gene expression differed between groups. These findings highlight the value of a genetically characterized hiPSC-based framework for investigating ancestry-associated phenotypes across cellular contexts.
papers.translated_summary: 祖先相关的基因组变异可能导致表型多样性。然而，其细胞层面的后果仍难以评估。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个基于人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）的框架来研究此类表型。我们以日本人群作为绳文相关与大陆东亚祖源混合的模型。使用绳文等位基因评分（JAS）估算的绳文祖源与临床指标相关，包括34,152名东北医疗大银行参与者的肾脏相关性状和血清甘油三酯。对JAS分布上端和下端极端供者（n = 10）的外周血单核细胞转录组学分析提示，免疫相关基因表达存在组间差异。为检验血清甘油三酯关联是否与肝细胞表型一致，我们将这些供者的hiPSC分化为肝细胞样细胞。两组之间的细胞内甘油三酯或脂质相关基因表达均无差异。这些发现凸显了经过遗传特征描述的基于hiPSC的框架在跨细胞背景研究祖源相关表型方面的价值。

papers.title: Cromosomal genomes assemblies of twelve sheep breeds
papers.translated_title: 十二个绵羊品种的染色体基因组组装
papers.author: ECHE, C.
papers.summary: The sheep research community benefits from a genome assembly that has been refined over the last 15 years. However, the rich diversity of sheep breeds suggests that a single individual genome is not enough to represent the species full genomic content. Third-generation sequencing technologies have recently made it possible to generate high quality assemblies that should enable to elucidate unique and/or complex phenotype determinisms depending on genetic structural variations. In the SeqOccin project, twelve breeds were selected to represent (mostly French) sheep genetic diversity: Basco-Bearnaise, Black Belly, Blanche du Massif Central, Corse, Ile de France, Lacaune, Manech Tete Noire, Noire du Velay, Ouessant, Rambouillet, Vendeen, Soay. High-molecular-weight DNA was extracted from blood samples and subjected to long read whole-genome sequencing. The reads were used to generate de novo assemblies and were aligned onto the public reference to call structural variants. PacBio HiFi and parental Illumina reads were used to assemble phased haplotypes of the Lacaune breed. For the other breeds, PacBio raw (CLR) or ONT reads were generated. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of assembling genomes with a reasonable amount of data and appropriate software packages, delivering one high-quality assembly and 11 standard sheep assemblies that pave the way for pangenome construction and structural variant functional studies.
papers.translated_summary: 绵羊研究界受益于过去15年间不断完善的基因组组装。然而，绵羊品种的丰富多样性表明，单个个体的基因组不足以代表该物种的全部基因组内容。第三代测序技术近来使得生成高质量组装成为可能，这些组装应有助于阐明取决于基因组结构变异的独特和/或复杂表型决定机制。在SeqOccin项目中，选择了十二个品种来代表（主要是法国的）绵羊遗传多样性：Basco-Bearnaise、Black Belly、Blanche du Massif Central、Corse、Ile de France、Lacaune、Manech Tete Noire、Noire du Velay、Ouessant、Rambouillet、Vendeen、Soay。从血液样本中提取高分子量DNA，并进行长读长全基因组测序。这些读长被用于生成从头组装，并比对到公共参考基因组上以检测结构变异。PacBio HiFi和亲本Illumina读长被用于组装Lacaune品种的分型单倍型。对于其他品种，则生成了PacBio原始（CLR）或ONT读长。我们的工作证明了以合理的数据量和适当的软件包组装基因组的可行性，提供了一个高质量组装和11个标准绵羊组装，为泛基因组构建和结构变异功能研究铺平了道路。

papers.title: The Genetic Landscape of Structural Variants in Aspergillus flavus using ONT and PacBio Sequencing
papers.translated_title: 利用ONT和PacBio测序技术揭示黄曲霉结构变异的遗传图谱
papers.author: Woods, A.
papers.summary: Genetic rearrangement in the absence of selection is poorly understood. Long-read, high-depth sequencing has enabled analysis of the genetic landscape of spontaneous structural variants. We have applied PacBio Revio sequencing to identify the major classes of genetic alterations during long-term vegetative growth in Aspergillus flavus. These classes include a) precise deletions frequently associated with the flanking region of homology, b) clusters of short deletions that are heavily enriched within centromeric and subtelomeric regions that are typically 94% A+T, and c) deletions and expansions within a subset of homopolymer tracts. We find 70 homopolymer tracts longer than 44 bp, dispersed throughout the genome in noncoding regions and unassociated with transposable elements. A broader analysis of third-generation sequenced datasets from fungi found within the Phylum Ascomycota showed a high but variable prevalence of homopolymeric tracts across species. The adventitious identification of a putative flbA mutation, responsible for an altered conidial phenotype, by the Deep Variant AI system also demonstrates the power of this approach. These studies show that high-depth, long-read sequencing can probe SNPs, indels, homopolymeric tracts, and large-scale rearrangements in an unbiased fashion, and demonstrate that short deletions and homopolymer tract expansions arise spontaneously in A. flavus and other filamentous fungi.
papers.translated_summary: 在没有选择压力下的遗传重排尚缺乏深入理解。长读长、高深度测序使得对自发结构变异的遗传图谱进行分析成为可能。我们应用PacBio Revio测序来鉴定黄曲霉在长期营养生长过程中的主要遗传改变类型。这些类型包括：a）常与侧翼同源区域相关的精确缺失，b）在通常为94% A+T的着丝粒和亚端粒区域内高度富集的短缺失簇，以及c）某一同聚物序列子集中的缺失和扩展。我们发现了70个长度超过44 bp的同聚物序列，分散于基因组非编码区域，且与转座元件无关。对子囊菌门真菌第三代测序数据集的更广泛分析显示，各物种间同聚物序列的流行率较高但存在差异。Deep Variant AI系统偶然鉴定出一个导致分生孢子表型改变的推定flbA突变，也证明了该方法的强大能力。这些研究表明，高深度、长读长测序能够以无偏倚的方式探测SNP、插入缺失、同聚物序列以及大规模重排，并证明短缺失和同聚物序列扩展在黄曲霉及其他丝状真菌中自发产生。

papers.title: GenDiMug: a generic inclusive multigraph framework to analyze genomic organizations and -omics data at multiple scales
papers.translated_title: GenDiMug：一个通用的包容性多重图框架，用于在多尺度上分析基因组组织和组学数据
papers.author: Teuliere, J.
papers.summary: After decades of investigation, analyses of genome organization remain challenging. This is because genome descriptions are very information-rich and usually rendered as a linear map of genomic features corresponding to an ordered list of position intervals on a nucleic acid macromolecular backbone. This formalism, while accurate, is not fully optimized to mathematically analyze all genome structural properties, in particular the relations between genomic features, nor to integrate large amounts of -omics data, such as transcriptomes, epigenomes, proteomes, meltomes or chromatin accessibility data, which are increasingly available. We therefore developed GenDiMug, a tool that uses a network representation of the genome as a backbone, providing a natural framework to integrate spatial and ontogenetic relationships between genomic features and multi-omics data. We illustrate how this generic approach can be applied to all sorts of genomes, both to visualize genomic topology at contig and chromosomal scales at base-pair resolution, and to analyze genome positional effects using various graph metrics. Using GenDiMug, we further reveal clumping of genes with similar expression levels in eukaryotic genomes and their possible circadian regulation in a photosynthetic alga.
papers.translated_summary: 经过数十年的研究，基因组组织的分析仍然具有挑战性。这是因为基因组描述信息极为丰富，通常以线性图谱的形式呈现，对应于核酸大分子骨架上按顺序排列的位置区间所对应的基因组特征。这种形式虽然准确，但并未完全优化到能够以数学方式分析所有基因组结构特性，特别是基因组特征之间的关系，也无法整合大量日益可得的组学数据，如转录组、表观基因组、蛋白质组、熔解组或染色质可及性数据。因此，我们开发了GenDiMug，这是一种以基因组的网络表示为骨架的工具，为整合基因组特征之间的空间和个体发生关系以及多组学数据提供了自然的框架。我们展示了这种通用方法如何应用于各种基因组，既能在碱基对分辨率下可视化重叠群和染色体尺度上的基因组拓扑结构，也能利用各种图论指标分析基因组位置效应。使用GenDiMug，我们进一步揭示了真核生物基因组中具有相似表达水平的基因成簇现象，以及它们在一种光合藻类中可能的昼夜节律调控。

papers.title: Inferring ecDNA Evolution from Allele Frequency Spectra
papers.translated_title: 从等位基因频率谱推断ecDNA进化
papers.author: Dameracharla, B.
papers.summary: Extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) can arise early in the development of aggressive tumors or later upon progression, but the impact of chronology on patient outcome is not known. Currently, it is not possible to determine when an ecDNA arose in the course of tumor development and progression, based on genome sequencing data. Here, we develop an analytic method, ecEvol, to infer ecDNA emergence time, selection strength, mutation rate, and clonal dominance from allele frequency spectra in bulk whole-genome sequencing. EcEvol outperforms other methods and predicts parameters with high accuracy across a wide range of parameter values. Applying ecEvol to primary, treatment-naive tumors, we find that ecDNA typically emerges early and undergoes strong positive selection, albeit with substantial variation across cancer types. EcDNAs carrying known oncogenes emerge earlier and reach greater clonal dominance than ecDNAs lacking known oncogenes. In advanced and predominantly treated tumors, ecDNA emerges substantially later than in matched primary tumors, consistent with the generation and selection of new ecDNA during tumor progression and therapy. Longitudinal samples further support continued expansion of ecDNA-bearing lineages. Finally, earlier ecDNA emergence is associated with poorer overall survival. These results provide insight into the chronology of ecDNA formation from a single tumor biopsy taken at any point during the course of the disease, revealing that allele-frequency spectra encode the evolutionary history of ecDNA and provide a quantitative framework for reconstructing its emergence and expansion.
papers.translated_summary: 染色体外DNA（ecDNA）可以在侵袭性肿瘤发展的早期出现，也可以在进展后期出现，但时间顺序对患者预后的影响尚不清楚。目前，基于基因组测序数据，尚无法确定ecDNA在肿瘤发展和进展过程中何时出现。在此，我们开发了一种分析方法ecEvol，可从bulk全基因组测序的等位基因频率谱推断ecDNA的出现时间、选择强度、突变率和克隆优势。EcEvol优于其他方法，并在广泛的参数值范围内以高精度预测参数。将ecEvol应用于原发性、未接受过治疗的肿瘤，我们发现ecDNA通常早期出现并经历强烈的正选择，尽管在不同癌症类型之间存在显著差异。携带已知癌基因的ecDNA比缺乏已知癌基因的ecDNA出现更早，并达到更大的克隆优势。在晚期且主要接受过治疗的肿瘤中，ecDNA的出现显著晚于匹配的原发肿瘤，这与肿瘤进展和治疗过程中新ecDNA的产生和选择一致。纵向样本进一步支持携带ecDNA的谱系持续扩张。最后，ecDNA出现较早与较差的总生存期相关。这些结果提供了对ecDNA形成时间顺序的见解，仅需在疾病过程中任何时间点采集的单个肿瘤活检样本，揭示了等位基因频率谱编码了ecDNA的进化历史，并为重建其出现和扩张提供了定量框架。

papers.title: In silico subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology approach reveal outer membrane proteins OMP47 and LptD as dual-purpose drug and vaccine targets in Pasteurella multocida Pm70
papers.translated_title: 计算机辅助消减基因组学和反向疫苗学方法揭示外膜蛋白OMP47和LptD作为多杀性巴氏杆菌Pm70的双用途药物和疫苗靶点
papers.author: Khan Chowdhury, A. R.
papers.summary: Drug targets and vaccines for bacterial diseases are challenging to develop. Computational subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology offer a viable substitute for conventional drug and vaccine development approaches. In recent years, Pasteurella multocida, a Gram-negative pathogen responsible for severe infections in humans along with major diseases in livestock and poultry, has developed resistance to multiple drugs. As a result, there is an urgent demand for research into reliable, efficient, highly potent, and cost-effective strategies to combat the rise of Pasteurella multocida infections. To address this, the present study integrated an in silico subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology workflow to pinpoint proteins with potential value as both drug and vaccine targets. From the complete Pasteurella multocida Pm70 proteome, we identified 446 proteins that had no similarities with human proteins, out of which 129 were found to be essential for the pathogens survival. These 129 proteins are therefore potential candidates for drug development. Further metabolic pathway analysis, virulence potential, subcellular localization, and structural analyses revealed two outer membrane proteins, namely, 47 kDa outer membrane protein and lipopolysaccharide-assembly protein LptD, as promising candidates for therapeutic development. Subsequent antigenicity analysis revealed both outer membrane proteins as potential vaccine targets, exhibiting highly favorable antigenicity scores. Candidate B- and T-cell epitopes were systematically mapped from these two targets based on antigenicity, immunogenicity, toxicity, and allergenicity potential and only high-confidence epitopes were assembled using adjuvants and class-specific linkers to construct the final multi-epitope vaccine (MEV). The designed MEV construct was demonstrated to be highly antigenic, non-toxic and non-allergenic to humans, while possessing favorable structural and physicochemical properties, and exhibited strong binding interactions with human toll-like receptors with minimal molecular deformability. Although further experimental validation is recommended to fully assess their efficacy, the present study establishes a solid foundation for the development of novel therapeutics and vaccine candidates against P. multocida, ultimately contributing to the reduction of its rising infections.
papers.translated_summary: 细菌疾病的药物靶点和疫苗开发具有挑战性。计算消减基因组学和反向疫苗学为传统药物和疫苗开发方法提供了一种可行的替代方案。近年来，多杀性巴氏杆菌是一种革兰氏阴性病原体，可引起人类严重感染以及家畜和家禽的主要疾病，已对多种药物产生耐药性。因此，迫切需要研究可靠、高效、高效力且具有成本效益的策略，以应对多杀性巴氏杆菌感染的增加。为解决这一问题，本研究整合了计算机消减基因组学和反向疫苗学工作流程，以识别具有作为药物和疫苗靶点潜在价值的蛋白质。从完整的多杀性巴氏杆菌Pm70蛋白质组中，我们鉴定出446种与人类蛋白质无相似性的蛋白质，其中129种被发现对病原体生存至关重要。因此，这129种蛋白质是药物开发的潜在候选者。进一步的代谢途径分析、毒力潜力、亚细胞定位和结构分析揭示了两种外膜蛋白，即47 kDa外膜蛋白和脂多糖组装蛋白LptD，作为治疗开发的有前景的候选者。随后的抗原性分析显示，这两种外膜蛋白均为潜在疫苗靶点，表现出非常有利的抗原性评分。基于抗原性、免疫原性、毒性和致敏潜力，从这两个靶点系统地映射了候选B细胞和T细胞表位，并且仅使用佐剂和类别特异性连接子组装高置信度表位，以构建最终的多表位疫苗。所设计的MEV构建体被证明具有高度抗原性、对人体无毒且无致敏性，同时具有良好的结构和理化性质，并与人Toll样受体表现出强结合相互作用，且分子变形性最小。尽管建议进一步实验验证以充分评估其效力，但本研究为开发针对多杀性巴氏杆菌的新型治疗药物和疫苗候选者奠定了坚实基础，最终有助于减少其不断上升的感染。

papers.title: Version-aware question answering over living oncology guidelines
papers.translated_title: 面向动态肿瘤学指南的版本感知问答
papers.author: Ravi Kumar, T.
papers.summary: Living clinical guidelines revise recommendations as evidence emerges, so an AI answer can be faithful to a real guideline and still be out of date. Here we examine this failure using ASCOBench, 288 unique questions in 96 three-turn conversations grounded in versioned American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) breast and prostate cancer guidelines, with oncologist-reviewed reference answers. Oncologists corrected one in four version-sensitive answers drafted by a frontier model, against fewer than one in ten factual ones. Across the guideline corpus, 19 recommendations changed between versions, seven of them reversals, yet only 1 of 14 superseded documents states that it has been replaced. With a strong model, retrieval over several guideline versions made stale answers four times more frequent than answering without retrieval. SentryLine, a verification-first system, lowered incorrect answers to 4.2-5.2% from 9.7-22.9% for baselines across three models. Recognizing change before a guideline declares it remains an open problem.
papers.translated_summary: 活体临床指南会随着新证据的出现而修订推荐意见，因此人工智能的回答可能忠实于真实指南却仍然过时。本文利用ASCOBench研究这一失效模式，该基准包含96组三轮对话中的288个独特问题，均以有版本记录的美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）乳腺癌和前列腺癌指南为依据，并配有经肿瘤科医生审核的参考答案。对于前沿模型起草的版本敏感型答案，肿瘤科医生纠正了四分之一，而对于事实型答案，纠正比例不到十分之一。在整个指南语料库中，有19条推荐意见在版本之间发生了变化，其中7条为反转，然而在14份被取代的文件中，只有1份声明其已被替换。使用强模型时，对多个指南版本进行检索使过时答案的出现频率达到不检索作答时的四倍。SentryLine这一验证优先的系统将错误答案从三个模型基线的9.7-22.9%降至4.2-5.2%。在指南自行声明变化之前识别变化，仍是一个未解决的问题。

papers.title: AI-Driven Design of Next-Generation Immunoinformatics Multi-Epitope Subunit Vaccine Targeting the Most Virulent Mpox Proteome: A Structural and Kinetic Validation Framework
papers.translated_title: AI驱动的下一代免疫信息学多表位亚单位疫苗设计靶向最具毒力的猴痘蛋白质组：一个结构与动力学验证框架
papers.author: Emon, M.
papers.summary: The resurgence of the Mpox virus (MPXV) highlights the urgent need for scalable, mutation-resistant countermeasures. Slow development timelines hinder traditional empirical vaccine discovery, while conventional vaccinology often yields high false-positive rates because it relies on static, linear sequence-based screening. These classical informatics filters consistently fail to predict physical structural stability or the dynamic presentation of immune cells under physiological conditions, creating a distinct translational gap between computational design and in vitro efficacy. To address these limitations, here we engineered an advanced, AI-augmented vaccine discovery pipeline targeting the most virulent components of the MPXV proteome. We systematically screened eight critical viral targets essential for replication, membrane morphogenesis, and host-cell entry to map highly conserved T-cell and B-cell epitopes. Moving beyond standard heuristic filtering, we implemented a high-fidelity deep learning validation layer: ESM-2 protein language models (pLMs) were deployed to calculate pseudo-perplexity scores across chimeric linker junctions (EAAAK, GPGPG) to guarantee structural naturalness, MHCflurry ensemble models successfully verified active intracellular antigen presentation, and structure-informed graph neural networks (GNNs) simulated the physical node-attention dynamics of the immune synapse. Finally, recurrent neural networks (RNNs)-driven mRNA kinetic modeling optimized translation initiation rates and minimum free energy profiles during in silico cloning. This multi-layered pipeline successfully yielded three structurally refined, multi-epitope vaccine constructs optimized for maximum global population coverage. ESM-2 structural validation confirmed exceptionally low perplexity scores at structural junctions, indicating that the engineered chimaeras have native-like stability and a minimized risk of proteolysis. GNN-based immune synapse modeling demonstrated highly stable binding kinetics and robust binding free energies between the target epitopes and human HLA alleles. Furthermore, RNN kinetic optimizations established that the cDNA sequences are optimized for high-yield expression in heterologous expression hosts without risk of ribosomal stalling or translational bottlenecks. This study establishes a deep learning-augmented framework that bridges the gap between theoretical sequence optimization and biopharmaceutical scalability. By validating the structural naturalness, real-world immunogenicity, and manufacturing kinetics of our vaccine chimeras, this framework presents a robust, proactive paradigm for rapid vaccine architecture against emerging orthopoxvirus threats.
papers.translated_summary: Mpox病毒（MPXV）的再度暴发凸显了对可规模化、抗突变对策的迫切需求。传统经验性疫苗研发周期缓慢，而常规疫苗学由于依赖静态、线性的基于序列的筛选，往往产生较高的假阳性率。这些经典的信息学过滤方法始终无法预测物理结构稳定性或免疫细胞在生理条件下的动态呈递，从而在计算设计与体外效力之间形成了明显的转化鸿沟。为解决这些局限，我们在此构建了一条先进的、AI增强的疫苗发现流程，靶向MPXV蛋白质组中毒力最强的组分。我们系统筛选了八个对复制、膜形态发生和宿主细胞入侵至关重要的关键病毒靶标，以绘制高度保守的T细胞和B细胞表位。超越标准的启发式过滤，我们实施了一个高保真深度学习验证层：部署ESM-2蛋白质语言模型（pLM）计算嵌合连接处（EAAAK、GPGPG）的伪困惑度评分，以保证结构自然性；MHCflurry集成模型成功验证了活跃的细胞内抗原呈递；结构信息引导的图神经网络（GNN）模拟了免疫突触的物理节点注意力动力学。最后，循环神经网络（RNN）驱动的mRNA动力学建模在计算机克隆过程中优化了翻译起始速率和最小自由能谱。这一多层流程成功产出了三个结构精炼的多表位疫苗构建体，并针对最大全球人群覆盖率进行了优化。ESM-2结构验证确认结构连接处具有极低的困惑度评分，表明工程化嵌合体具有类天然稳定性且蛋白质水解风险最小化。基于GNN的免疫突触建模展示了靶表位与人HLA等位基因之间高度稳定的结合动力学和稳健的结合自由能。此外，RNN动力学优化确认cDNA序列已针对异源表达宿主中的高产量表达进行了优化，且无核糖体停滞或翻译瓶颈风险。本研究建立了一个深度学习增强框架，弥合了理论序列优化与生物制药可规模化之间的鸿沟。通过验证我们疫苗嵌合体的结构自然性、真实世界免疫原性和制造动力学，该框架为快速构建疫苗架构以应对新发正痘病毒威胁提供了一种稳健、主动的范式。

papers.title: Rare genetic variants influence participation in cognitive components of the UK Biobank
papers.translated_title: 罕见遗传变异影响英国生物银行认知组成部分的参与
papers.author: Fenner, E.
papers.summary: Population-level biobanks are transforming health and genomic research however they are all subject to recruitment and participation biases, the impacts of which are not fully understood. The UK Biobank (UKBB) is one such cohort; it is widely used for health-related research, but its participants are not representative of the UK general population. In addition, those who complete optional components of UKBB differ from those who do not in terms of health-related exposures and outcomes. Participation in UKBB has a partly genetic basis, but the extent to which rare variants influence participation in optional study components, and how this might impact findings of rare variant association studies, is unknown. We analysed exome sequencing and array data from 398,149 UKBB participants to examine rare variant contributions to UKBB participation bias, focusing on cognitive phenotypes. We found that classes of rare variation previously shown to contribute to cognition were enriched among participants who completed fewer cognitive tests. We then compared the effects of rare variants on cognition itself between groups of participants defined by whether they completed all online cognitive tests. Rare variants had significantly weaker effects on cognition in individuals who completed all online cognitive tests than in those who did not. These findings demonstrate that participation is a non-random phenotype that is influenced by rare variants, and that individuals who engage in optional UKBB components are not representative of the broader cohort. We show how participation bias can reduce the power of rare variant association studies, potentially masking true associations. This bias should therefore be carefully considered when interpreting results derived from phenotypes with substantial missingness.
papers.translated_summary: 群体级生物样本库正在改变健康与基因组研究，但它们都受到招募和参与偏倚的影响，而这些偏倚的影响尚未被完全理解。英国生物样本库（UK Biobank，UKBB）就是这样一个队列；它被广泛用于健康相关研究，但其参与者并不能代表英国普通人群。此外，完成 UKBB 可选部分的人在健康相关暴露和结局方面与未完成者不同。参与 UKBB 具有部分遗传基础，但罕见变异在多大程度上影响对可选研究部分的参与，以及这可能如何影响罕见变异关联研究的结果，尚不清楚。我们分析了 398,149 名 UKBB 参与者的外显子组测序和芯片数据，以考察罕见变异对 UKBB 参与偏倚的贡献，重点关注认知表型。我们发现，先前被证明与认知有关的几类罕见变异在完成较少认知测试的参与者中富集。随后，我们根据参与者是否完成了所有在线认知测试进行分组，比较了罕见变异对认知本身的影响。在完成所有在线认知测试的个体中，罕见变异对认知的影响显著弱于未完成者。这些发现表明，参与是一种非随机表型，受到罕见变异影响，并且参与 UKBB 可选部分的个体不能代表更广泛的队列。我们展示了参与偏倚如何降低罕见变异关联研究的效力，可能掩盖真实关联。因此，在解释来自具有大量缺失的表型的结果时，应仔细考虑这种偏倚。

papers.title: Worldwide diversity and geographic structure of killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptor (KIR) gene content
papers.translated_title: 全球杀伤细胞免疫球蛋白样受体（KIR）基因含量的多样性与地理结构
papers.author: Obeso Fernandez, A.
papers.summary: Introduction: Killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptor (KIR) gene content shapes natural killer-cell responses and varies substantially among populations. We examined whether worldwide KIR diversity reflects regional structure, isolation by distance, serial founder effects, or latitudinal gradients. Data and methods: Carrier frequencies for 11 variable KIR genes were obtained from the Allele Frequency Net Database. The primary analysis included 189 locally sampled, non-diaspora, non-mixed populations from 70 countries, comprising 25,469 individuals; 161 populations had complete 11-gene profiles. Diversity indices, ordination, clustering, permutation-based variance decomposition, Mantel tests, and regression models were used to characterize geographic structure. Serial founder effects were evaluated using four distance measures from East Africa, both globally and within the Old World. Models of latitude incorporated spatial autocorrelation. Prespecified sensitivity analyses evaluated alternative population sets, gene panels, geographic classifications, weighting schemes, and multivariate outlier exclusion. Results: Geographic region explained 53.5% of variation in KIR profiles, substantially exceeding the permutation-null expectation of 6.9%, although multivariate dispersion differed among regions. Twenty-five of 28 pairwise regional comparisons remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. Isolation by distance was modest (Mantel r=0.3003) and weakened after controlling for region (r=0.1557). KIR diversity did not decline with distance from East Africa globally but decreased strongly within the Old World (expected heterozygosity {beta}=-0.0066 and standardized gene content {beta}=-0.0789). B-content decreased nominally with absolute latitude, but latitude was collinear with region and the association survived neither spatial modelling nor sensitivity analyses. Regional differentiation remained robust across analytical specifications, whereas the Old World decline was carried by gene content once standard errors were clustered by country. Conclusion: Worldwide KIR gene-content variation shows pronounced regional differentiation, modest isolation by distance, and no independent latitudinal gradient. Diversity declines with distance from East Africa across the Old World, supporting serial founder effects, but not once the Americas and Oceania are included.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：杀伤细胞免疫球蛋白样受体（KIR）基因内容塑造自然杀伤细胞反应，并在人群间存在显著差异。我们检验了全球KIR多样性是否反映区域结构、距离隔离、系列奠基者效应或纬度梯度。数据与方法：从等位基因频率网络数据库获取11个可变KIR基因的携带频率。主要分析纳入来自70个国家的189个本地采样、非侨民、非混合人群，共25，469名个体；161个人群具有完整的11基因谱。采用多样性指数、排序、聚类、基于置换的方差分解、Mantel检验和回归模型来刻画地理结构。使用来自东非的四种距离度量，在全球范围内和旧世界内部评估系列奠基者效应。纬度模型纳入空间自相关。预设的敏感性分析评估了替代人群集、基因组合、地理分类、加权方案和多变量离群值排除。结果：地理区域解释了KIR谱变异的53.5%，大幅超过置换零假设预期的6.9%，尽管多变量离散度在区域间存在差异。在错误发现率校正后，28个区域两两比较中有25个仍显著。距离隔离程度中等（Mantel r=0.3003），在控制区域后减弱（r=0.1557）。KIR多样性在全球范围内未随距东非距离增加而下降，但在旧世界内部强烈下降（期望杂合度{beta}=-0.0066，标准化基因内容{beta}=-0.0789）。B内容名义上随绝对纬度增加而下降，但纬度与区域共线，该关联在空间建模和敏感性分析中均未存活。区域分化在所有分析设定下均保持稳健，而旧世界内部的下降在标准误按国家聚类后由基因内容承载。结论：全球KIR基因内容变异显示出显著的区域分化、中等的距离隔离，且无独立的纬度梯度。多样性在旧世界范围内随距东非距离增加而下降，支持系列奠基者效应，但一旦纳入美洲和大洋洲则不再支持。

papers.title: Costs of influenza-associated healthcare: an umbrella review and meta-regression analysis
papers.translated_title: 流感相关医疗保健的费用：一项伞状综述与元回归分析
papers.author: Goodfellow, L.
papers.summary: Abstract Background Estimates of the healthcare costs associated with influenza treatment are essential for cost-effectiveness analyses that inform preventative and treatment strategies such as vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions. Existing evidence varies across treatment settings, age groups, and countries and there is little data from low- and middle-income settings. Methods We conducted an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses reporting direct admitted and non-admitted hospitalisation costs of seasonal influenza treatment in children, adults, and older people. We supplemented an evidence gap with a systematised review of studies reporting adult non-admitted treatment costs. Costs were extracted and adjusted to 2023 USD. We fitted a Bayesian mixed-effects model to estimate influenza treatment costs using national economic indicators, age group, and treatment setting as a priori predictors. We predicted admitted and non-admitted treatment costs for children, adults, and older people in 195 countries and territories. Results Seven reviews were included in the umbrella review, supplemented by 17 primary studies for adult non-admitted care. Extracted data points most frequently described admitted treatment costs and came from high-income countries. The best-fitting model used healthcare expenditure per capita to predict treatment costs, with country-level random effects. Estimated costs increased with healthcare expenditure per capita, were higher for admitted than non-admitted care, and were highest for adults and lowest for children. Conclusions This study provides novel estimates of influenza-associated healthcare costs across age groups and treatment settings by synthesising the available global evidence. By extrapolating to settings without data, our estimates can inform future economic evaluation studies of influenza interventions worldwide.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景 与流感治疗相关的医疗成本估算对于成本效果分析至关重要，这些分析可为疫苗接种和非药物干预等预防和治疗策略提供依据。现有证据因治疗场所、年龄组和国家而异，且来自中低收入环境的数据很少。 方法 我们对报告儿童、成人和老年人季节性流感治疗直接住院和非住院医院成本的系统综述和荟萃分析进行了伞形综述。我们通过一项系统化综述补充了成人非住院治疗成本研究报告的证据缺口。提取成本并调整为2023年美元。我们拟合了一个贝叶斯混合效应模型，使用国家经济指标、年龄组和治疗场所作为先验预测因子来估算流感治疗成本。我们预测了195个国家和地区儿童、成人和老年人的住院和非住院治疗成本。 结果 伞形综述纳入了7篇综述，并由17项关于成人非住院治疗的原始研究补充。提取的数据点最常描述住院治疗成本，且来自高收入国家。最佳拟合模型使用人均医疗支出来预测治疗成本，并包含国家层面随机效应。估算成本随人均医疗支出增加而增加，住院治疗高于非住院治疗，成人最高，儿童最低。 结论 本研究通过综合现有全球证据，提供了不同年龄组和治疗场所的流感相关医疗成本的新估算。通过外推到没有数据的地区，我们的估算可为全球流感干预措施的未来经济评估研究提供依据。

papers.title: Data-efficient machine learning for the detection of duodenal neoplasia: a multi-centre study
papers.translated_title: 数据高效机器学习用于十二指肠肿瘤检测：一项多中心研究
papers.author: Di Lisio, F.
papers.summary: Background: Machine Learning (ML) has shown promise in histopathological diagnosis, but rare tumours, like duodenal epithelial neoplasms, are challenging because large, labelled datasets are difficult to assemble. We propose a data-efficient ML pipeline for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia in whole-slide images. Methods: We assembled a five-hospital dataset of haematoxylin and eosin-stained duodenal biopsy whole slide images (WSIs) at 10x magnification, comprising 8,027 normal and 401 neoplastic biopsies, including adenomas, carcinomas and neuroendocrine tumours. WSIs were divided into patches and encoded using the Hibou-B foundation model. We compared global standardisation with unsupervised site-specific standardisation of patch embeddings. Our pipeline combined principal component analysis, a Gaussian mixture model and a Random Forest classifier. We assessed generalisability using leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation across four hospitals and on an independent test set from a fifth hospital. Results: In leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation, the pipeline achieved a mean accuracy of 90%, sensitivity of 96%, specificity of 83% and an AUC of 0.96. On the external test hospital, it achieved 94% accuracy, 93% sensitivity, 95% specificity, and AUC of 0.97. Site-specific standardisation improved mean cross-validation accuracy by 20 percentage points compared with global standardisation, while the Gaussian mixture pipeline improved accuracy by 12 percentage points compared with mean pooling of patch embeddings. Conclusions: We present a data-efficient ML approach for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia from WSIs. Strong performance was maintained across hospitals and on an independent external test cohort despite the limited number of neoplastic training cases, supporting the feasibility of foundation-model-based approaches for rare histopathological diagnoses.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：机器学习（ML）在组织病理学诊断中已展现出前景，但罕见肿瘤，如十二指肠上皮肿瘤，由于难以构建大型标注数据集而具有挑战性。我们提出了一种数据高效的ML流程，用于在全切片图像中检测十二指肠上皮肿瘤。方法：我们构建了一个来自五家医院的苏木精-伊红染色十二指肠活检全切片图像（WSIs）数据集，放大倍数为10倍，包含8，027例正常活检和401例肿瘤性活检，包括腺瘤、癌和神经内分泌肿瘤。WSIs被划分为图像块，并使用Hibou-B基础模型进行编码。我们比较了图像块嵌入的全局标准化与无监督位点特异性标准化。我们的流程结合了主成分分析、高斯混合模型和随机森林分类器。我们通过在四家医院进行留一医院交叉验证，并在来自第五家医院的独立测试集上进行评估，以评估泛化能力。结果：在留一医院交叉验证中，该流程实现了平均准确率90%、灵敏度96%、特异度83%和AUC 0.96。在外部测试医院上，它实现了94%的准确率、93%的灵敏度、95%的特异度和AUC 0.97。与全局标准化相比，位点特异性标准化将平均交叉验证准确率提高了20个百分点，而高斯混合流程与图像块嵌入的平均池化相比将准确率提高了12个百分点。结论：我们提出了一种数据高效的ML方法，用于从WSIs中检测十二指肠上皮肿瘤。尽管肿瘤性训练病例数量有限，但在各医院以及独立外部测试队列中均保持了强劲的性能，支持基于基础模型的方法用于罕见组织病理学诊断的可行性。

papers.title: Exposure Records Preserved by Two Users of Japan's COVID-19 Contact-Confirming Application During the Seventh Wave: A Descriptive Study
papers.translated_title: 日本第七波疫情期间两名COVID-19接触确认应用程序用户保留的暴露记录：一项描述性研究
papers.author: Nakagawa, S.
papers.summary: Introduction: Japan's COVID-19 Contact-Confirming Application (COCOA) stopped functioning in November 2022, and the records held on users' devices were lost with it. We describe the exposure records preserved by two users during the seventh wave of COVID-19 in Japan and the changes around the revision of full mandatory case reporting on September 26, 2022. Methods: We analyzed exposure windows (date, duration, and minimum attenuation) contained in files exported from the app. Observer 1 worked at a hospital in Tokyo and commuted almost exclusively by private car; Observer 2 lived in Kyoto Prefecture and spent most of the time at home. Seven-day rolling sums of exposure windows were compared descriptively with daily new case counts in each prefecture. Results: During the common pre-revision period (April 3 to September 25, 2022; 176 days), Observer 1 recorded 358 exposure windows and Observer 2 recorded 261. The rolling sums rose in July and fell in September, as did new case counts (r-squared = 0.807 and 0.397), but week-on-week changes corresponded weakly (r-squared = 0.183 and 0.002). Of the windows in this period, 97.2% and 93.1% had a minimum attenuation of 65 dB or more, the bucket given the lowest weight in the notification decision. After the revision, Observer 1 recorded three windows in 27 days (45 in the preceding 27 days), and Observer 2 recorded none in 23 days (25 in the preceding 27 days). Conclusions: The exposure-window records of two users rose and fell with the seventh wave, although the correspondence of week-to-week changes was limited. Recorded windows decreased after the revision, but the effects of the policy change, the supply of diagnosis keys, app usage, and operating-system updates cannot be separated. This descriptive report does not evaluate the preventive effectiveness of COCOA. It shows that indicator definitions, retrieval dates, and the history of software and policy changes are essential when records left on users' devices are analyzed after the fact.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：日本的COVID-19接触确认应用（COCOA）于2022年11月停止运行，随之丢失了用户设备上保存的记录。我们描述了两位用户在日本第七波COVID-19期间保存的暴露记录，以及2022年9月26日全面强制病例报告修订前后的变化。方法：我们分析了从该应用导出文件中包含的暴露窗口（日期、时长和最低衰减值）。观察者1在东京一家医院工作，几乎完全通过私家车通勤；观察者2居住在京都府，大部分时间待在家中。我们将暴露窗口的7天滚动总和与各都道府县的每日新增病例数进行了描述性比较。结果：在共同的修订前时期（2022年4月3日至9月25日；176天），观察者1记录了358个暴露窗口，观察者2记录了261个。滚动总和在7月上升，9月下降，新增病例数也是如此（r平方=0.807和0.397），但周环比变化的对应关系较弱（r平方=0.183和0.002）。在这一时期的窗口中，分别有97.2%和93.1%的最低衰减值为65 dB或以上，这是通知决策中权重最低的区间。修订后，观察者1在27天内记录了3个窗口（此前27天为45个），观察者2在23天内未记录任何窗口（此前27天为25个）。结论：两位用户的暴露窗口记录随第七波疫情上升和下降，尽管周环比变化的对应关系有限。修订后记录的窗口减少，但政策变化、诊断密钥供应、应用使用和操作系统更新的影响无法分离。这份描述性报告并未评估COCOA的预防效果。它表明，在事后分析用户设备上留下的记录时，指标定义、检索日期以及软件和政策变化的历史至关重要。

papers.title: A Stratified Worm Burden Framework for Endemic Equilibria, Demography, and Mass Drug Administration: Linking Classical Macroparasite Models to Transmission Dynamics
papers.translated_title: 分层虫负荷框架：地方性平衡、人口学与大规模给药——连接经典宏观寄生虫模型与传播动力学
papers.author: Gurarie, D.
papers.summary: Background. Classical macroparasite models commonly represent worm burden heterogeneity through prescribed Poisson or negative-binomial (NB) distributions, while transmission dynamics are formulated in terms of aggregate quantities such as mean worm burden and prevalence. We revisit these assumptions using a stratified worm burden (SWB) framework that explicitly tracks the distribution of parasite burdens across heterogeneous host classes and allows demographic turnover, transmission, and interventions to be analyzed within a unified model. Methods. We derive equilibrium distributions of the SWB system under homogeneous and heterogeneous infection processes and compare them with the classical Poisson and NB distributions used in macroparasite epidemiology and control policymaking. The framework is then extended to include host demography, coupled human-snail transmission dynamics, and periodic mass drug administration (MDA). Corresponding SWB and NB-type MacDonald models are calibrated to comparable endemic prevalence and mean worm burden, allowing direct comparison of potential transmission breakpoints and intervention outcomes. Results. In the absence of demographic turnover, the SWB framework naturally generates Poisson and NB equilibrium distributions as limiting cases of homogeneous and heterogeneous infection processes. Incorporating demographic recruitment and mortality alters these benchmark distributions, producing endemic burden structures that differ systematically from their classical counterparts. Analysis of coupled human-snail systems reveals that transmission breakpoints and bistable equilibria occur only within a relatively restricted region of SWB parameter space. In contrast, comparable NB-MacDonald formulations exhibit breakpoint behavior over substantially broader parameter ranges with the net effect of overestimating the likelihood of interruption of transmission. Although calibrated models can reproduce near identical endemic prevalence and mean worm burden, they often generate markedly different responses to MDA, including differences in rebound dynamics, persistence, and elimination thresholds. Conclusions. The SWB framework links classical statistical descriptions of worm aggregation to mechanistic burden-resolved population dynamics, clarifying how endemic distributions emerge and how they are modified by demography and control interventions. Our results suggest that transmission breakpoints are not a universal feature of helminth systems but depend strongly on model structure, and that predictions of elimination and post-treatment recovery may be considerably more model-dependent than implied by prevalence-based calibration alone. The SWB approach therefore provides a flexible alternative framework for evaluating parasite transmission dynamics and predicting the outcomes of control strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。经典大型寄生虫模型通常通过预设的泊松分布或负二项分布来表示蠕虫负荷的异质性，而传播动力学则以平均蠕虫负荷和患病率等聚合量来表述。我们使用分层蠕虫负荷框架重新审视这些假设，该框架明确追踪异质性宿主类别间寄生虫负荷的分布，并允许在统一模型中分析人口更替、传播和干预。方法。我们推导了同质和异质感染过程下分层蠕虫负荷系统的平衡分布，并将其与大型寄生虫流行病学和控制政策制定中使用的经典泊松分布和负二项分布进行比较。随后将该框架扩展至包含宿主人口统计学、人-螺耦合传播动力学以及周期性大规模药物给药。相应的分层蠕虫负荷模型和负二项型MacDonald模型被校准至可比的地方性患病率和平均蠕虫负荷，从而可以直接比较潜在的传播阈值和干预结果。结果。在不存在人口更替的情况下，分层蠕虫负荷框架自然生成泊松分布和负二项分布作为同质和异质感染过程的极限情形。引入人口补充和死亡后，这些基准分布发生改变，产生与经典对应物系统性不同的地方性负荷结构。对耦合人-螺系统的分析表明，传播阈值和双稳态平衡仅出现在分层蠕虫负荷参数空间中相对有限的区域内。相比之下，可比的负二项-MacDonald公式在更广泛的参数范围内表现出阈值行为，其净效应是高估了传播中断的可能性。尽管校准后的模型可以重现几乎相同的地方性患病率和平均蠕虫负荷，但它们对大规模药物给药的反应往往显著不同，包括反弹动力学、持续性和消除阈值方面的差异。结论。分层蠕虫负荷框架将蠕虫聚集的经典统计描述与机制性的负荷分辨种群动力学联系起来，阐明了地方性分布如何出现以及它们如何被人口统计学和控制干预所改变。我们的结果表明，传播阈值并非蠕虫系统的普遍特征，而是强烈依赖于模型结构，并且对消除和治疗后恢复的预测可能比仅基于患病率校准所暗示的更加依赖于模型。因此，分层蠕虫负荷方法为评估寄生虫传播动力学和预测控制策略结果提供了一个灵活的替代框架。

papers.title: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A(H7N7) Virus, Taiwan, 2026
papers.translated_title: 2026年台湾人感染甲型H7N7禽流感病毒
papers.author: Li, Y.-T.
papers.summary: Low pathogenic avian influenza A(H7N7) virus detected in a poultry worker in Taiwan, 2026 was related to viruses circulating in Asian wild birds and possessed PB2 E627K, a mammalian adaptation marker. Enhanced surveillance for H7 viruses in poultry and rapid characterization of human cases are essential to assess pandemic potential.
papers.translated_summary: 2026年在台湾一名家禽工人中检测到低致病性甲型H7N7禽流感病毒，该病毒与亚洲野鸟中流行的病毒相关，并携带PB2 E627K这一哺乳动物适应标志。加强对家禽中H7病毒的监测以及对人类病例的快速表征，对于评估大流行潜力至关重要。

papers.title: Microbial traits have minimal power for predicting death from bloodstream infection
papers.translated_title: 微生物特征对预测血流感染致死几乎没有预测能力
papers.author: Gilliland, R.
papers.summary: Bloodstream infection (BSI) is a life-threatening condition where the risk of dying is affected by both patient- and pathogen-related factors. Certain microbial traits (e.g., virulence genes) are thought to affect survival rates from BSIs, but the magnitude of their impact on human mortality remains unclear. To address this, we analyzed the microbial genomes, quantitative proteomes, and electronic medical records (EMRs) from 35,746 BSIs from Calgary, Canada (2006-2022). We show that EMR-based machine learning models accurately predict 30-day mortality (AUC=0.83), but surprisingly, integrating >70,000 microbial genes/proteins does not improve this performance. We demonstrate that microbial factors co-segregate with specific patient cohorts and are therefore not independent predictors of risk. We conclude that microbial virulence factors have minimal impact on mortality rates from BSIs.
papers.translated_summary: 血流感染（BSI）是一种危及生命的状况，其死亡风险受患者和病原体相关因素的双重影响。某些微生物特征（如毒力基因）被认为会影响BSI的存活率，但其对人类死亡率的实际影响程度仍不明确。为解决这一问题，我们分析了来自加拿大卡尔加里（2006-2022年）的35,746例BSI的微生物基因组、定量蛋白质组和电子病历（EMR）。我们发现，基于EMR的机器学习模型能准确预测30天死亡率（AUC=0.83），但令人惊讶的是，整合超过70,000个微生物基因/蛋白质并未提升这一预测性能。我们证明微生物因素与特定患者群体共分离，因此并非独立的风险预测因子。我们得出结论：微生物毒力因子对BSI死亡率的影响极小。

papers.title: SCORES (Selection of Clinical Observations for Risk Evaluation Scores): Impact of Heart Rate Selection on Simplified Geneva Score Performance in Suspected Pulmonary Embolism
papers.translated_title: SCORES（临床观察指标选择用于风险评估评分）：心率选择对疑似肺栓塞中简化日内瓦评分性能的影响
papers.author: Cole, C.
papers.summary: Abstract Background The Simplified Geneva Score (SGS) incorporates two heart-rate thresholds. Multiple heart-rate measurements are commonly recorded during emergency department (ED) assessment. While the original SGS specifies use of mean heart rate, real-world implementation is unlikely to reflect this, and the effect of alternative heart-rate selection methods on score performance is unknown. Methods SCORES was a retrospective within-subject study of consecutive ED patients at a single urban hospital undergoing computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) for suspected pulmonary embolism (PE). Four SGS variants were calculated using the first, highest, mean, and lowest recorded pre-CTPA heart rate. Outcomes included score output, risk classification, diagnostic performance, reclassification flow, and downstream imaging utilisation. Precision estimates and comparisons were derived using empirical resampling techniques. Results 590 episodes were reviewed with 581 included for analysis. PE was confirmed in 50 cases (8.6%). Mean SGS differed significantly across all heart-rate implementations (p<0.0001). The proportion classified as high risk varied from 15% using the lowest heart rate to 40% using the highest heart rate. Reclassification across the SGS threshold was common, with 25% of episodes changing risk category unidirectionally between lowest and highest heart rate implementations. SGS(lowest HR) compared with SGS(mean HR) and SGS(highest HR) demonstrated higher specificity (87.6% vs 73.4% vs 62.1%), improved AUROC (0.744 vs 0.704 vs 0.659), and reduced downstream CTPA utilisation (818 vs 876 vs 920 scans per 100 PEs diagnosed), with no additional pulmonary emboli missed within the complete diagnostic pathway. Conclusions Heart-rate selection materially influences SGS output, risk classification, diagnostic performance, and imaging utilisation. In this retrospective cohort, use of the lowest recorded heart rate produced the most favourable overall balance of discrimination and diagnostic efficiency, supporting prospective validation.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景 简化日内瓦评分（SGS）包含两个心率阈值。急诊科（ED）评估期间通常会记录多次心率测量值。虽然原始SGS规定使用平均心率，但实际应用不太可能反映这一点，而替代性心率选择方法对评分性能的影响尚不清楚。 方法 SCORES是一项回顾性受试者内研究，纳入某城市单一医院连续就诊的急诊科患者，这些患者因疑似肺栓塞（PE）接受计算机断层肺血管造影（CTPA）。使用CTPA前记录的首个、最高、平均和最低心率计算四种SGS变体。结局包括评分输出、风险分类、诊断性能、重分类流程和下游影像利用。精确度估计和比较采用经验重采样技术得出。 结果 共审查590次发作，581次纳入分析。50例确诊PE（8.6%）。不同心率实施方式之间的平均SGS存在显著差异（p<0.0001）。被归类为高风险的比例从使用最低心率的15%到使用最高心率的40%不等。跨SGS阈值的重分类很常见，25%的发作在最低和最高心率实施方式之间单向改变风险类别。与SGS（平均心率）和SGS（最高心率）相比，SGS（最低心率）表现出更高的特异性（87.6% vs 73.4% vs 62.1%）、改善的AUROC（0.744 vs 0.704 vs 0.659），并减少了下游CTPA利用（每诊断100例PE分别为818 vs 876 vs 920次扫描），且在完整诊断路径中未额外漏诊肺栓塞。 结论 心率选择对SGS输出、风险分类、诊断性能和影像利用产生实质性影响。在该回顾性队列中，使用记录的最低心率在区分度和诊断效率之间产生了最有利的总体平衡，支持进行前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Carbonaceous Components Underlying Wildfire Smoke PM2.5-Associated Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias in Older US Adults
papers.translated_title: 美国老年人中与野火烟雾PM2.5相关的阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症背后的碳质组分
papers.author: Jin, Z.
papers.summary: Wildfire smoke exposure is increasing across the U.S., but the long-term neurological effects of smoke-specific fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and its carbonaceous components remain uncertain. Using Medicare data from 2002 through 2019, we examined incident Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) among 39,678,630 fee-for-service Medicare beneficiaries followed from 2005 through 2019. We identified 3,501,414 incident AD cases over 258.5 million person-years and 8,377,416 incident ADRD cases over 248.6 million person-years. We linked the cohort with annual, high-resolution estimates of smoke and non-smoke PM2.5 mass and carbonaceous components (elemental and organic carbon) and fitted stratified Cox proportional hazards models. Per 1 g/m3 increase, smoke PM2.5 was associated with incident AD (hazard ratio [HR], 1.015, 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.005-1.026) and ADRD (1.029 [1.024-1.035]). Smoke carbonaceous fraction was also associated with AD (1.063 [1.042-1.085]) and ADRD (1.090 [1.077-1.103]). Within the ADRD endpoint, smoke-related associations exceeded their corresponding non-smoke associations on a per-unit-mass basis. Per interquartile range, associations were smaller for smoke PM2.5 (AD, 1.005 [1.002-1.008]; ADRD, 1.009 [1.008-1.011]) than for non-smoke PM2.5 (AD, 1.086 [1.079-1.094]; ADRD, 1.048 [1.043-1.053]). Associations varied across geographic, racial, socioeconomic, and clinical subgroups. Long-term wildfire smoke exposure, particularly its carbonaceous fraction, was associated with higher incidence of AD and ADRD among older U.S. adults. The associations correspond to 2,284 and 11,142 incident cases per year of AD and ADRD attributable to smoke PM2.5 among older Medicare beneficiaries, with the carbonaceous fraction accounting for most of this burden. These findings support the use of source-resolved and composition-specific smoke metrics in dementia research and wildfire-smoke health-impact assessments.
papers.translated_summary: 野火烟雾暴露在美国日益增加，但烟雾特异性细颗粒物（PM2.5）及其碳质组分对神经系统的长期影响仍不确定。我们利用2002年至2019年的Medicare数据，研究了39,678,630名按服务收费的Medicare受益人中新发的阿尔茨海默病（AD）以及阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD），随访时间为2005年至2019年。我们在258.5百万人年中识别出3,501,414例新发AD病例，在248.6百万人年中识别出8,377,416例新发ADRD病例。我们将该队列与烟雾和非烟雾PM2.5质量及碳质组分（元素碳和有机碳）的年度高分辨率估计值相链接，并拟合分层Cox比例风险模型。每增加1 g/m3，烟雾PM2.5与新发AD相关（风险比[HR]，1.015，95%置信区间[CI]，1.005-1.026）和ADRD相关（1.029 [1.024-1.035]）。烟雾碳质组分也与AD相关（1.063 [1.042-1.085]）和ADRD相关（1.090 [1.077-1.103]）。在ADRD终点内，按单位质量计算，烟雾相关关联超过相应的非烟雾关联。按四分位距计算，烟雾PM2.5的关联较小（AD，1.005 [1.002-1.008]；ADRD，1.009 [1.008-1.011]），而非烟雾PM2.5的关联较大（AD，1.086 [1.079-1.094]；ADRD，1.048 [1.043-1.053]）。这些关联在地理、种族、社会经济和临床亚组之间存在差异。长期野火烟雾暴露，尤其是其碳质组分，与美国老年人AD和ADRD发病率升高相关。这些关联对应于老年Medicare受益人中每年可归因于烟雾PM2.5的2,284例AD和11,142例ADRD新发病例，其中碳质组分占该负担的大部分。这些发现支持在痴呆研究和野火烟雾健康影响评估中使用源解析和组分特异性的烟雾指标。
